exposure: Cord blood vitamin D status (deficient, insufficient, sufficient)
cohort: The study participants were 265 mother-infant pairs recruited at a single center during the postpartum period.
finding: Infant cord blood vitamin D deficiency/insufficiency is common and is associated with younger maternal age, increased gravidity, and non-White race/ethnicity.
cross-section timing: At birth (cord blood samples) and pre-discharge (neonatal characteristics)
